assessment.weighting: Autumn 1: role models, sports, free time. Autumn 2: shopping and clothes. Writing needs opinions, connectives and a range of examples.

mock.note: 30 reading and vocabulary questions. For writing, use the Written practice tab.

leitner_plan.quiz: Spanish mock (30), then one writing task

leitner_plan.new: None. Reading and writing exam today

cards.title: Ir, jugar and hacer
cards.question: How do you say I go, I play and I do in Spanish, and which activities go with each verb?
points: ir (to go): voy (I go), va (he or she goes), vamos (we go). Voy al cine, al parque, al estadio, a la ciudad.
jugar (to play a sport or game): juego, jugamos. Juego al fútbol, al baloncesto, al tenis, a los videojuegos.
hacer (to do): hago, hacemos. Hago deporte, natación, ciclismo, ejercicio, los deberes.
Other activities: toco el piano (I play the piano), canto, leo, bailo, veo la tele, cocino, corro, monto en bicicleta.
cards.watch_out: Use tocar for instruments, not jugar. Toco la guitarra.
cards.hook: a + el = al. Voy al cine (to the cinema), but voy a la ciudad.
cards.grade9: Use two people and two verbs in one sentence: Juego al tenis pero mi hermana hace natación.

cards.title: Regular present tense endings
cards.question: How do you form the present tense of regular -ar, -er and -ir verbs?
points: Remove -ar, -er or -ir, then add the ending.
-ar (bailar): bailo, bailas, baila, bailamos, bailáis, bailan.
-er (leer): leo, lees, lee, leemos, leéis, leen.
-ir (escribir): escribo, escribes, escribe, escribimos, escribís, escriben.

example.heading: Examples
lines: Mi amigo lee revistas. (My friend reads magazines.)

cards.watch_out: The I form always ends in -o: hablo, como, vivo. Irregular I forms: voy, hago, juego, soy, tengo.
cards.hook: O for me, s for you, a or e for he or she.
cards.grade9: Switch between I, he or she and we in your writing to show you control the verb.

cards.title: Time markers and frequency
cards.question: How do you say when and how often you do activities?
points: los fines de semana (at weekends), por la tarde (in the afternoon), más tarde (later), mañana (tomorrow), este sábado (this Saturday).
Seasons: en invierno, en primavera, en verano, en otoño.
a las dos (at two o'clock), después de (after).
Frequency: a menudo (often), a veces (sometimes), siempre (always), nunca (never), generalmente (generally).
cards.watch_out: Put nunca before the verb: Nunca juego al golf.
cards.hook: Seasons in order from winter: In Paris Very Old (invierno, primavera, verano, otoño).
cards.grade9: Start a sentence with a time phrase to vary your openings: Los fines de semana, hago natación.

cards.title: Membership, teams and passions
cards.question: How do you say you are a member of a team or club, and that something is your passion?
points: Soy miembro de un equipo de baloncesto. (I am a member of a basketball team.)
Soy miembro de la orquesta. (I am a member of the orchestra.)
en mi colegio (at my school), con mis amigos (with my friends).
Es mi pasión. (It is my passion.)

example.heading: Model sentence
lines: Soy miembro de un equipo de baloncesto en mi colegio. ¡Es mi pasión!

cards.watch_out: Spanish puts the noun first: un equipo de baloncesto, a team of basketball.
cards.grade9: Add who with: con mis amigos, con mi hermana.

cards.title: Name, age and birthday
cards.question: How do you say a person's name, age and birthday in Spanish?
points: Mi modelo favorito se llama Lionel Messi. (My favourite role model is called Lionel Messi.)
Tiene treinta y nueve años. Spanish uses tener (to have) for age.
Su cumpleaños es el veinticuatro de junio. (His birthday is the 24th of June.)
Numbers: veinte 20, treinta 30, cuarenta 40, cincuenta 50. Treinta y nueve = 39.
cards.watch_out: Never say es 39 años. Always tiene ... años.
cards.hook: In Spanish you HAVE years: tengo, tiene.
cards.grade9: Use su for his or her: su cumpleaños, sus ojos.

cards.title: Describing appearance
cards.question: How do you describe someone's hair and eyes?
points: Tiene el pelo negro. (He has black hair.) Tiene los ojos marrones. (He has brown eyes.)
Hair: largo (long), corto (short), rubio (blond), castaño (brown), rizado (curly), liso (straight).
Eyes: azules, verdes, marrones, grises.
Adjectives come after the noun and agree: los ojos azules (plural).
cards.watch_out: Ojos is plural, so the colour must be plural: ojos verdes, not ojos verde.
cards.hook: Spanish says the hair black, the eyes brown: noun first, colour second.
cards.grade9: Combine features with y and pero: Tiene el pelo corto y rizado pero no lleva gafas.

cards.title: Personality and why I admire someone
cards.question: How do you describe personality and say why you admire someone?
points: Es deportivo or deportiva (sporty), trabajador (hard-working), generoso (generous), divertido (fun), inteligente.
Admiro a esta persona famosa ya que es deportiva. (I admire this famous person given that they are sporty.)
Le gusta el fútbol. (He likes football.)
Adjectives agree: masculine -o, feminine -a. Inteligente stays the same.
cards.watch_out: Use the personal a after admirar: Admiro a Messi.
cards.hook: Ya que and dado que both mean given that. Use them instead of porque to sound advanced.
cards.grade9: Give two reasons with different connectives: Admiro a Messi ya que es trabajador y además es muy generoso.

cards.title: Weather expressions
cards.question: How do you describe the weather and say what you do in different weather?
points: Cuando llueve (when it rains), cuando hace sol (when it is sunny), cuando hace frío (cold), cuando hace calor (hot), cuando hay viento (when it is windy).
Cuando llueve, uso mi móvil o leo revistas en casa.
Sin embargo, cuando hace sol, prefiero correr en el parque para hacer ejercicio.
cards.watch_out: Most weather uses hace, not es. Hace frío, not es frío.
cards.hook: Hace for heat, cold and sun. Wind: hay viento or hace viento. Llueve on its own.
cards.grade9: Contrast two weathers with sin embargo, and add para + infinitive for a purpose.

cards.title: Preferring and wanting with the infinitive
cards.question: How do you use prefiero, me gusta and me encanta with a verb?
points: After these phrases use the infinitive (the -ar, -er, -ir form).
Me gusta leer. Me encanta bailar. Prefiero correr. Odio cocinar.
No me gusta practicar ciclismo dado que pienso que es duro.
para + infinitive = in order to: para hacer ejercicio.
cards.watch_out: Me gusta jugar, not me gusta juego.
cards.hook: Like, love, prefer, hate: then the verb stays whole (infinitive).
cards.grade9: Add an opinion and a reason after each preference to extend your sentence.

cards.title: The near future: going to
cards.question: How do you say what you are going to do this weekend?
points: ir a + infinitive: voy a jugar (I am going to play), va a ver (he is going to watch), vamos a salir (we are going to go out).
Este fin de semana, voy a ir al cine con mis amigos.
Use time phrases: este sábado, mañana, el domingo por la tarde.
cards.watch_out: Do not forget the a: voy a jugar, not voy jugar.
cards.grade9: Use two tenses in one sentence: Normalmente juego al fútbol, pero este sábado voy a ir al cine.

cards.title: Want to and must
cards.question: How do you say what you want to do and what you have to do?
points: quiero + infinitive: Quiero ver una película. (I want to watch a film.)
tengo que + infinitive: Tengo que hacer los deberes. (I have to do my homework.)
me gustaría + infinitive: Me gustaría ir a la playa. (I would like to go to the beach.)
cards.watch_out: Tengo que needs the que. Tengo hacer is wrong.
cards.grade9: Contrast want and must: Quiero jugar a los videojuegos pero tengo que estudiar.

cards.title: Opinion phrases
cards.question: What phrases can you use to give opinions in Spanish?
points: Pienso que, creo que (I think that), diría que (I would say that), en mi opinión, a mí (to me).
porque es divertido, fácil, sano (healthy), duro (hard), aburrido.
Es una pérdida de tiempo. (It is a waste of time.)
Use a range: me gusta, me encanta, prefiero, no me gusta nada, odio.
cards.watch_out: Me gusta is singular, me gustan is plural: me gustan los videojuegos.
cards.hook: PCD for opinions: Pienso que, Creo que, Diría que.
cards.grade9: Justify every opinion and vary the starter each time.

cards.title: Connectives and complex structures
cards.question: Which connectives and complex phrases help you write longer, higher-level sentences?
points: y (and), pero (but), también (also), además (in addition), sin embargo (however), o (or).
porque (because), ya que and dado que (given that), para (in order to).
cuando (when): Cuando hace sol, prefiero correr.
A mí, me encanta hacer deporte dado que es sano.
cards.watch_out: Además and sin embargo usually start a new sentence followed by a comma.
cards.hook: Spice it up with SPADE: Sin embargo, Para, Además, Dado que, Entonces.
cards.grade9: Aim for one connective and one opinion in every sentence you write.

cards.title: Writing a good paragraph
cards.question: How do you build a strong paragraph for the writing task?
points: 1. Introduce: Mi modelo favorito se llama...
2. Describe: tiene..., es...
3. Activities with time phrases and two people.
4. Opinions with reasons and connectives.
5. A different tense: este fin de semana voy a...

example.heading: Model paragraph
lines: A mí, me encanta hacer deporte dado que es sano. Juego al baloncesto a menudo y además hago natación los fines de semana. Sin embargo, cuando llueve, prefiero leer en casa. Este sábado voy a ir al estadio con mis amigos.

cards.watch_out: Check accents and agreement at the end. Leave 5 minutes.
cards.grade9: Include a near future and the present in the same paragraph.

cards.title: Clothes and colours
cards.question: How do you say what clothes someone wears and their colours?
points: llevo (I wear), lleva (he or she wears).
una camiseta (T-shirt), una camisa (shirt), una falda (skirt), unos vaqueros (jeans), unos pantalones (trousers), un jersey (jumper), unas zapatillas (trainers), un vestido (dress).
Colours agree: una camiseta roja, unos pantalones negros, una falda azul (azul stays the same).
el uniforme escolar (school uniform).
cards.watch_out: Colours ending in -o change to -a for feminine nouns: roja, blanca, negra.
cards.hook: Llevo = I wear (think: I lug it around).
cards.grade9: Give an opinion on uniform with a reason: Llevo uniforme, pero en mi opinión es incómodo.

cards.title: Shopping phrases
cards.question: What do you say when shopping for clothes?
points: ¿Cuánto cuesta? (How much does it cost?) Cuesta veinte euros.
Quisiera or me gustaría comprar... (I would like to buy...)
¿Tiene esta camiseta en azul? (Do you have this T-shirt in blue?)
Es demasiado caro (too expensive) or barato (cheap). Me queda bien (it fits me well).
cards.watch_out: Cuesta for one item, cuestan for more than one: los vaqueros cuestan treinta euros.
cards.hook: Caro sounds like car: a car is expensive.
cards.grade9: Add a comparison: La camiseta es más barata que el jersey.

cards.title: Comparisons
cards.question: How do you compare two things in Spanish?
points: más ... que (more ... than): Messi es más rápido que yo.
menos ... que (less ... than): El tenis es menos divertido que el fútbol.
tan ... como (as ... as): Mi hermana es tan deportiva como yo.
mejor (better), peor (worse).
cards.watch_out: Better is mejor, not más bueno.
cards.grade9: Use a comparison in each paragraph to reach higher marks.

cards.title: Key verbs and checking
cards.question: Can you give the I and he or she forms of the key irregular verbs?
points: ir: voy, va. jugar: juego, juega. hacer: hago, hace.
tener: tengo, tiene. ser: soy, es. llevar: llevo, lleva.
querer: quiero, quiere. preferir: prefiero, prefiere.
Check: accents, adjective agreement, a connective in every sentence, an opinion with a reason.
cards.watch_out: Accents change meaning: el (the) and él (he).
cards.grade9: Proofread for three things only: verb endings, agreement, accents.

written.q: Write 4 sentences in Spanish about your favourite role model. Include name, age, appearance, personality and why you admire them.
model: Hair or eyes with correct agreement (1)
Reason with ya que or dado que (1)

written.q: Write 5 sentences in Spanish about your free time. Include sports, time phrases, another person and opinions.
model: A time phrase or frequency word (1)
Another person, such as mi hermana hace (1)
A connective such as además or sin embargo (1)

written.q: Write 3 sentences in Spanish about your plans for this weekend.
Translate into Spanish: When it rains, I read magazines at home. However, when it is sunny, I prefer to run in the park.
model: Cuando llueve, leo revistas en casa (1)

written.q: Write 3 sentences in Spanish about what you wear at the weekend and what you would like to buy.

exam_tips.timing: Reading and writing is 50 minutes. Do the reading first (about 25 minutes), then plan and write.
section_a: Read the questions first, then the text, underlining words you know.
Use cognates (words that look like English) such as natación, fútbol, música.
Watch for negatives (no, nunca) and time words, which change the meaning.
section_b: Every sentence needs a verb, and most need an opinion and a connective.
Use at least two tenses (present and going to).
Check accents, verb endings and adjective agreement at the end.
grade9: Add a reason whenever you give an opinion: Admiro a mi madre porque es trabajadora.
Say one sentence in three times: juego, jugué, voy a jugar.
Join simple, accurate ideas before trying hard language: La camiseta roja es cara pero bonita.
week: Most days, 10 to 15 minutes: press Start today (due cards, the new batch, then a short quiz).
Once a week, 10 minutes: say three sentences about your day out loud in Spanish, one in the past, one now, one about tomorrow. Then write them down and check the verbs.
Once a week: a quiz on the Quiz tab that mixes older units with this week's, so earlier topics stay in.
Fix one mistake: rewrite one wrong answer or one watch out from memory, then check it against the card.
